title: Missing Gear of Ancient Clock

scenes.text: What 2,000‑year‑old device lost a crucial gear?

scenes.label: It was complete
scenes.text: People think the Antikythera Mechanism was fully intact when found.

scenes.label: Gear missing
scenes.text: Only 30 of the original 30‑plus gears survived; a missing gear explains why parts of the calendar are unreadable.

scenes.label: Incomplete Artifact
scenes.text: The mystery isn’t alien tech – it’s incomplete preservation.
Follow for the cases no one can explain.

description: The Antikythera Mechanism dazzles us, but a missing gear still hides parts of its function. Discover what scholars really know.
